quests.question: My uncle is generous ___ always brings gifts when he visits.
quests.hint: Two positive qualities describe the same person together.
quests.explanation: 'And' adds a second matching quality — he is both generous and thoughtful with gifts.

quests.question: I returned the shoes ___ they didn't fit properly.
quests.hint: A fit problem explains the return.
quests.explanation: 'Because' explains the reason for an action — the poor fit caused the return.

quests.question: The jacket was expensive, ___ I bought it anyway.
quests.hint: The high cost didn't stop the purchase — that's unexpected.
quests.explanation: 'But' shows contrast — despite the high price, the purchase still happened.

quests.question: My phone freezes ___ too many apps are open at once.
quests.hint: The freezing happens under one specific circumstance.
quests.explanation: 'When' shows the exact circumstance that causes the freezing — too many open apps.

quests.question: You can restart the router ___ the Wi-Fi stops working.
quests.hint: Restarting is the solution tied to one condition.
quests.explanation: 'If' introduces a condition — restarting is the plan only when the Wi-Fi fails.

quests.question: The laptop overheated, ___ he turned it off to cool down.
quests.hint: Overheating directly led to an action.
quests.explanation: 'So' introduces the result — overheating caused him to switch the laptop off.

quests.question: The dog barked ___ the mail carrier walked past the gate.
quests.hint: Two things happened at the exact same time.
quests.explanation: 'While' connects two simultaneous actions — the barking and the walking overlapped.

quests.question: The kitten hid under the bed ___ the thunder frightened her.
quests.hint: Fear explains the hiding.
quests.explanation: 'Because' gives the reason for the kitten's behavior — the thunder caused the fear.

quests.question: Does your parrot prefer seeds ___ fruit?
quests.hint: A choice between two foods is being asked about.
quests.explanation: 'Or' presents two food options — only one will be the parrot's preference.

quests.question: Warm up properly ___ you start any exercise.
quests.hint: One habit should always come first.
quests.explanation: 'Before' places warming up ahead of exercising in time.

quests.question: ___ our team lost the match, everyone played their best.
quests.hint: Losing is real, but genuine effort still happened.
quests.explanation: 'Although' introduces a concession — despite losing, the effort was real.

quests.question: She trains every morning ___ reviews her technique every evening.
quests.hint: Two separate daily habits are both true for her.
quests.explanation: 'And' links two habits that both happen — morning training and evening review.

quests.question: We can't go camping ___ Dad finishes work early.
quests.hint: Only one condition would allow the trip to happen.
quests.explanation: 'Unless' means 'except if' — Dad finishing early is the one requirement.

quests.question: The kids played in the park ___ the streetlights came on.
quests.hint: Playing continued right up to one signal.
quests.explanation: 'Until' marks the stopping point — the streetlights signaled the end of playtime.

quests.question: The weather forecast looked bad, ___ the sun came out anyway.
quests.hint: The prediction and the actual outcome didn't match.
quests.explanation: 'But' introduces an unexpected contrast — a bad forecast didn't match the sunny reality.

quests.question: I set two alarms ___ I often oversleep.
quests.hint: Oversleeping explains the extra precaution.
quests.explanation: 'Because' gives the reason for setting two alarms — a tendency to oversleep.

quests.question: The house feels quiet ___ everyone leaves for work.
quests.hint: The quiet happens at one particular moment.
quests.explanation: 'When' points to the specific time the house becomes quiet — right after everyone leaves.

quests.question: The kettle whistled loudly, ___ I hurried into the kitchen.
quests.hint: The sound led directly to an action.
quests.explanation: 'So' introduces a result — the whistle caused a quick response.

quests.question: I bought extra batteries ___ the power goes out tonight.
quests.hint: You're preparing for something that might happen, not something certain.
quests.explanation: 'In case' prepares for a possible event — the batteries are a precaution, not a certainty.

quests.question: The instructions were simple, ___ many people still got confused.
quests.hint: A surprising outcome follows a simple setup.
quests.explanation: 'Yet' shows unexpected contrast, similar to 'but' — simple instructions still led to confusion.

quests.question: Neighbors chatted ___ they waited for the bus together.
quests.hint: Two things happened at the same time — talking and waiting.
quests.explanation: 'While' shows two actions happening together — the chatting filled the waiting time.

quests.question: Both my grandmother ___ my mother taught me to bake bread.
quests.hint: 'Both' always pairs with one specific word to include two people.
quests.explanation: 'Both...and' links two people who share the same role — both women taught the same skill.

quests.question: You can choose either the red backpack ___ the blue one.
quests.hint: 'Either' always pairs with one specific word when offering two choices.
quests.explanation: 'Either...or' presents exactly two options — only one will be chosen.

quests.question: The store closed early ___ the holiday fell on a Monday.
quests.hint: A specific calendar fact explains the early closing.
quests.explanation: 'Because' introduces the reason behind an event — the holiday date explains the early closing.

quests.question: Neither the coffee shop ___ the bakery was open on Sunday.
quests.hint: 'Neither' always pairs with one word to exclude both options.
quests.explanation: 'Neither...nor' excludes both items together — both places were closed.

quests.question: I enjoy hiking, ___ my brother prefers swimming.
quests.hint: Two different preferences are placed side by side.
quests.explanation: 'While' can also show contrast between two related facts — two siblings, two different hobbies.

quests.question: You'll feel proud ___ you finish this book by yourself.
quests.hint: Finishing on your own leads to one particular feeling.
quests.explanation: 'If' introduces the condition for feeling proud — completing the book alone is the requirement.

quests.question: I'll text you ___ I arrive at the station.
quests.hint: The message will be sent at one exact future moment.
quests.explanation: 'When' introduces a future time clause — the text will be sent right at arrival.

quests.question: She wasn't hungry at lunch, ___ she skipped the meal.
quests.hint: Not being hungry led directly to a decision.
quests.explanation: 'So' introduces a result — the lack of hunger caused her to skip lunch.

quests.question: ___ it was very cold outside, the children built a snowman for hours.
quests.hint: Cold weather is a real obstacle, but it didn't stop the fun.
quests.explanation: 'Although' introduces a concession — despite the cold, the children kept playing outside.
